confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of credential stuffing/brute force followed by a successful login from an anomalous IP, privilege escalation, bulk data exfiltration, and anti-forensic activity (log deletion) by user_09. Additionally, user_02 exhibited suspicious cross-departmental access patterns.

attack_chain.description: Brute force/credential stuffing attempt via multiple failed logins from an external IP (185.220.101.45).
Successful unauthorized login for user_09 from the anomalous IP.
Unauthorized privilege escalation to an elevated role.
Bulk exfiltration of sensitive marketing files (15 files downloaded in rapid succession).
Anti-forensic activity: deletion of authentication logs to hide traces of the intrusion.

gaps: Confirmation if user_02's cross-departmental access was part of a separate insider threat or a coincidence.
Verification of whether the IP 185.220.101.45 is a known malicious/Tor exit node.
Logs from before the deletion to see if other users were compromised.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_09's account after a series of failed login attempts from an external IP. Once inside, the attacker escalated privileges, performed a bulk download of marketing data, and deleted authentication logs to cover their tracks. A secondary suspicious pattern was noted with user_02 accessing multiple departments' files.
